map.由衰变常数与时间求已衰变份额: Find the decayed fraction from the decay constant and time
map.输入衰变常数 λ 与时间 t，求已衰变份额。: Enter the decay constant λ and the time t to get the decayed fraction.
map.📖 查看「由衰变常数与时间求已衰变份额 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the decayed fraction from the decay constant and time"
map.f = 1 − e^(−λt) 求经时间 t 已衰变比例。: f = 1 - e^(-λt) gives the proportion already decayed after time t.
map.辐照、储存时间设计。: Design of irradiation and storage times.
map.对比不同 λt 的衰变程度。: Compare the extent of decay for different λt.
map.当 t=1/λ 时 f=1−e⁻¹≈63.2%，即平均寿命内约 2/3 衰变。: when t = 1/λ, f = 1 - e⁻¹ ≈ 63.2%, so about two thirds decay within one mean life.
map.衰变份额与存活概率关系？: Relation between decayed fraction and survival probability?
map.存活概率 P=e^(−λt)，衰变份额 f=1−P，二者互补，见 surviva: Survival probability P = e^(-λt) and decayed fraction f = 1 - P are complementary; see survival-probability.
map.此时约 63.2% 衰变，是衰变速率的常用参考点。: About 63.2% has then decayed, a common reference point when discussing decay rates.
